chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from Hassan ibn Mukhtar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'What is al-wisal in fasting?' He said, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no continuous fasting, nor silence from day until night, nor emancipation before ownership.'

key_terms.الْوِصَالُ: Continuous fasting without breaking the fast at night

ai.seo_question: What is the definition and ruling of continuous fasting (Wisal) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the prohibition of *al-wisal* (continuous fasting without breaking the fast at sunset) by attributing the ruling directly to the Prophet Muhammad, emphasizing the balance between worship and physical sustenance. It further clarifies that this prohibition extends to maintaining silence (*samt*) from day until night and freeing a slave before acquiring full ownership, reflecting the jurisprudential precision of the Imams in defining ritual purity and practicality.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Hassan Bin Mukhtar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is the continuation regarding the Fasting?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is neither a continuation (without breaking Fast) regarding the Fasting, nor a silence for the day up to the night, nor an emancipation before ownership’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from Hassan ibn Mukhtar who has said the following: “I asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’

What is continuous fasting?’ He replied, ’The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “There must be no continuous fasting, no fasting in the form of remaining silent the whole day, and setting free of a slave before owning is invalid.’””
